rationale: C115 flagged two basis_spread values as outside the expected percentage range, but the raw schedule supports both extracted values: the Volante row shows 16.50% in the Reference Rate and Spread column and 16.50% PIK as the interest rate, and the second-lien row under Equinox shows 16.00% in the same schedule position and 16.00% PIK as the interest rate. The source therefore supports the stored whole-number percentage values, so the range check is over-firing rather than exposing a source-backed data defect.
